items.key: It runs once, this year only — the repeating plan does not reach these months on its own, so this ground will likely need the same kind of one-off help again next year unless the plan itself changes.
items.draft: Senziwa kube kanye, kulo nyaka kuphela — isicwangciso esiphindaphindayo asifikeleli kwezi nyanga ngokwaso, ngoko loo mhlaba uya kudinga ngokuqinisekileyo uncedo olunjalo lwexesha elinye kunyaka olandelayo ngaphandle kokuba isicwangciso ngokwaso sitshintshile.
items.backtranslation: Made once, only this year — the repeating plan does not reach these months by itself, so that land will certainly need such one-season help next year unless the plan itself changes.
items.corrected: Senziwa kube kanye, kulo nyaka kuphela — isicwangciso esiphindaphindayo asifikeleli kwezi nyanga ngokwaso, ngoko kusenokwenzeka ukuba loo mhlaba udinge uncedo olunjalo lwexesha elinye kunyaka olandelayo ngaphandle kokuba isicwangciso ngokwaso sitshintshile.

items.key: 1 growing area has a stretch with no new sowing: {where}.
items.draft: Indawo yokulima enye inesithuba esingenakuhlwayelwa kutsha: {where}.
items.backtranslation: One growing place has a gap that cannot be sown freshly: {where}.
items.problem: "a stretch with no new sowing" became "a gap that cannot be sown fresh" (none scheduled vs impossible).
items.corrected: Indawo yokulima enye inesithuba apho kungekho kuhlwayela kutsha: {where}.

items.key: {n} growing areas have a stretch with no new sowing: {where}.
items.draft: Iindawo zokulima ezi-{n} zinesithuba esingenakuhlwayelwa kutsha: {where}.
items.backtranslation: {n} growing places have a gap that cannot be sown freshly: {where}.
items.corrected: Iindawo zokulima ezi-{n} zinesithuba apho kungekho kuhlwayela kutsha: {where}.

items.key: A vegetable crop could cover them, but the planner will not put a vegetable on a traced field on its own — planted at full block width that is a sizeable commitment, so it is left as your decision.
items.draft: Isityalo semifuno singazigubungela, kodwa icwangcisi ayizukubeka umfuno kwintsimi ehlanjululweyo yodwa — ukutyala ngobubanzi obupheleleyo bebhloko luxanduva olukhulu, ngoko kushiyelwe isigqibo sakho.
items.backtranslation: A vegetable crop could cover them, but the planner will not place a vegetable on a thinned-out field alone — planting across the whole width of the block is a big responsibility, so your decision is left.
items.problem: "traced field" (a field drawn on the map) rendered "ehlanjululweyo" (rinsed/diluted); "on its own" (automatically) lost.
items.corrected: Isityalo semifuno singazigubungela, kodwa icwangcisi ayizukubeka umfuno ngokwayo kwintsimi ezotywe kwimephu — ukutyala ngobubanzi obupheleleyo bebhloko luxanduva olukhulu, ngoko kushiyelwe isigqibo sakho.

items.key: Broad automatic choices use crops with verified yield, duration and field spacing so their productivity comparison has a common evidence basis.
items.draft: Ukhetho olubanzi olujikelezayo lusebenzisa izityalo ezinesivuno, ixesha nesithuba sensimi eziqinisekisiweyo ukuze uthelekiso lwazo lwemveliso lube nesiseko esifanayo sobungqina.
items.backtranslation: The wide rotating choice uses crops with confirmed yield, time and field spacing so that their production comparison has the same basis of evidence.
items.corrected: Ukhetho olubanzi olwenziwa ngokuzenzekelayo lusebenzisa izityalo ezinesivuno, ixesha nesithuba sensimi eziqinisekisiweyo ukuze uthelekiso lwazo lwemveliso lube nesiseko esifanayo sobungqina.

items.key: Maize was not placed for you: the app can measure mapped area, but it cannot draw or check a wind-pollinated maize block.
items.draft: Umbona awubekwanga ngenxa yakho: i-app inokulinganisa indawo ekwimephu, kodwa ayinakuyilanda okanye ihlole ibhloko yombona edliwa ngumoya.
items.backtranslation: Maize was not placed for you: the app can measure a place on the map but cannot follow or check a wind-eaten block of maize.
items.corrected: Umbona awubekwanga ngenxa yakho: i-app inokulinganisa indawo ekwimephu, kodwa ayinakuyizoba okanye ihlole ibhloko yombona exhomekeke emoyeni ekuhambiseni impova.

items.key: Check the actual vine path or trellis before accepting; mapped area alone does not prove that sprawling room works.
items.draft: Jonga indlela yokwenene yesityalo esikhasayo okanye iindlela zaso phambi kokuvuma; indawo ekwimephu yodwa ayibonisi ukuba indawo yokuhlandlekela iyasebenza.
items.backtranslation: Check the real way of the climbing crop or its ways before agreeing; a map place alone does not show that the climbing place works.
items.corrected: Jonga indlela yokwenene yesityalo esikhasayo okanye isakhelo sokusikhasisa phambi kokuvuma; indawo ekwimephu yodwa ayibonisi ukuba indawo yokuhlandlekela iyasebenza.
